artifact.reason: Foundation service for watch time data. Provides WatchTimeMetrics, WatchTimeTrend, TopVideo interfaces. getWatchTimeMetrics() returns totalWatchTimeMinutes, averageViewDurationSeconds, completionRate - data needed for retention curve calculation.
Content metadata service. ContentMetadata interface includes contentType (post/reel/story), publishedAt. Used to identify video content for retention analysis.
Daily metrics service. DailyMetricData includes videoViews - needed for calculating retention percentages at different points.
Reference pattern for analysis service structure. Shows how to create sub-analyzers, generate suggestions, and calculate scores. Similar pattern can be used for retention analysis.
Reference pattern for analysis display component. Shows expandable sections, score display, suggestions list. Similar UI patterns for retention curve display.
Reference for chart-based visualization. Shows how to display time-based data with insights.
